segments.script: [EN: Warm up.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Monday.] [PAUSE 3s] [VI: Thứ hai.] [EN: Bigger.] [PAUSE 3s] [VI: Lớn hơn.] [EN: I am a teacher.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Tôi là giáo viên.] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Kỹ sư.] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: Engineer.] [EN: Good.]

[EN: To say how you feel, use] [VI: thấy,] [EN: to feel, before the adjective. Happy is] [VI_F: Vui.] [EN: a flat tone. I feel happy.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Tôi thấy vui.] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Sad is] [VI_F: Buồn.] [EN: a falling tone. Tired is] [VI_F: Mệt.] [EN: a falling, broken tone. I feel tired.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Tôi thấy mệt.] [EN: Good. You can also stack degree: I feel very tired.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Tôi thấy rất mệt.] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Drill. Happy.] [PAUSE 3s] [VI: Vui.] [EN: Sad.] [PAUSE 3s] [VI: Buồn.] [EN: Tired.] [PAUSE 3s] [VI: Mệt.] [EN: I feel happy.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Tôi thấy vui.] [EN: I feel a bit tired.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Tôi thấy hơi mệt.] [EN: Now reverse.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Buồn.] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: Sad.] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Mệt.] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: Tired.] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Listen.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Sao anh buồn vậy?] [VI_M: Dạ, hôm nay tôi hơi mệt.] [VI_F: Vậy nghỉ đi nha.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Now you try. Say, I feel happy.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Tôi thấy vui.] [EN: Say, I feel a bit tired.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Tôi thấy hơi mệt.] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Tomorrow you ask how someone is. The preview phrase is] [VI: sao rồi] [EN: which means how's it going.]
